notes.title: v0.1.2 - Point collection effects
notes.content:
[b]General changes[/b]

+ added point collection effect
+ quests now fade out when being completed
+ changed quest overview to show the points gained from it
+ names of landmarks now shown when hovering over it with the mouse

[b]Buildings / Tiles[/b]

+ added oil platform

notes.title: Update 0.1.1 - Biomes and Ocean
notes.content:
[b]General changes[/b]
+ added polar and desert biome to the earth planet type
+ rotation now follows the planet axis to keep camera orientation
+ increased difficulty
- removed full desert and full ice planet

[b]Buildings / Tiles[/b]
+ added fish (randomly generated on the planet)
+ added fishing boat
+ added palms
+ added oasis

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
- new packages button only works when packages are available
- fixed bug showing a tutorial part too early
